n_inthis.text: In this video, I'll show you how to verify your identity on TAG Markets, step by step, on your phone.

n_ov1.text: You'll tap upload documents, tap Continue, and confirm your country.

n_ov2.text: Then you'll verify your email, create your Sumsub I D, and choose your I D card.

n_ov3.text: Finally, you'll allow the camera, scan your I D, and take a quick selfie.

s_dash.text: On your TAG Markets dashboard, tap upload documents.

s_cont.text: You opened it from TAG Markets, so tap Continue.

s_country.text: Confirm your country of residence, then tap Agree and continue.

s_email.text: Under Get verified faster with Sumsub I D, enter the same email you've used from the start, and tap Start verification.

s_code.text: Sumsub emails you a six digit code. Type it in, and never share this code with anyone.

s_save.text: Read the consent, tick the box, and tap Create my account.

s_created.text: Your Sumsub I D account is created. Tap Continue verification.

s_doc.text: Choose your issuing country and your document. I chose Identity Card.

s_double.text: If your card has two sides, tick My document is double-sided, then tap Continue.

s_ready.text: Read the tips: a well lit room, no reflections, and never edit the images. Tap Continue.

s_allow.text: When your browser asks to use the camera, tap Allow.

s_bubble.text: It says this site can't ask for your permission? Close screen recorders and chat bubbles, like WhatsApp, then tap Try again.

s_scan.text: Hold your I D card inside the frame. It takes the photo by itself. If it doesn't, move the phone back a little. Do the front, then the back.

s_selfie.text: Step two is a quick selfie. Find a well lit place, keep your face in the frame, and remove your hat, glasses or mask.

s_hold.text: Hold still until you see All set.

s_other.text: If it says your documents were submitted on another profile, you already have a TAG Markets profile. One person, one profile. Contact your sponsor or TAG Markets support.

s_done.text: That's it! TAG Markets reviews your documents, and once you're verified, you can make your first deposit.

r1.text: You tapped upload documents, tapped Continue, and confirmed your country.

r2.text: You verified your email, created your Sumsub I D, and chose your I D card.

r3.text: Then you allowed the camera, scanned your I D, and took a quick selfie.

x1.text: In the next video, part four, I'll show you how to fund your TAG Markets account.

x2.text: You'll tap Deposit, choose crypto, and send from your exchange on the same network.
